text: dsh-hindsight-local 是面向 DSH 的本机项目记忆插件，通过 agents 服务注册记忆工具，并在会话钩子中注入知识页索引、检索相关事实及回写对话。它可按项目目录分配 bank，支持查询和阅读知识页、检索与保存事实、跨事实反思，并在会话结束保存进度快照供下次会话参考。适合希望在 DSH 中延续项目背景和会话进度的开发者。需要准备本机 Hindsight 服务及用于记忆抽取的 LLM 配置；默认 API 地址为本机 127.0.0.1。

dsh-hindsight-local adds local project memory to DSH. Hooks inject knowledge pages and facts, retain conversation turns, and save a handoff snapshot. Tools search pages, recall and save facts, and reflect across memories. It needs a local Hindsight server and LLM configuration.
想让 DSH 记住不同项目的历史决策，下次开会话还能查到。
能不能在每轮结束后保存对话要点，并在新会话里带回上次进度？
I want DSH to recall project knowledge and carry the last session’s progress into a new session.
dsh-hindsight-local 的功能「项目记忆检索与写入」：模型可搜索并读取项目知识页、按问题召回事实、保存新事实或请求跨事实反思；通过对应 hindsight_local 工具触发，bank 按会话工作目录选择。
dsh-hindsight-local 的功能「会话记忆与进度接续」：会话开始时可注入知识页索引和相关事实，一轮结束后回写最近对话，会话结束时保存诉求与结论快照，后续会话可检索上次进度。
dsh-hindsight-local 使用前须知：自动回写的会话内容交给 Hindsight 服务处理，记忆抽取会调用所配置的 LLM API；默认提供商为 DeepSeek，密钥可由配置或环境变量提供。

dsh-hindsight-local README · dsh-hindsight-local：Run the [Hindsight](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight) memory server **on your own machine** and load it as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. Memory extraction, embedding, retrieval and knowledge pages all stay local; the LLM is the provider you already pay for (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama / …). Nothing is sent to a hosted memory service.

dsh-hindsight-local README · dsh-hindsight-local：It is the local counterpart of the official `@vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents` plugin: same mental model (one bank per repository, LLM-maintained knowledge pages, per-session injection), but self-hosted and free apart from your own model calls.

dsh-hindsight-local README · What it does：- **Runs the server**: finds the `hindsight-api` binary already cached by `uv`, probes `/health`, and starts it detached when it is not running (polls until ready, 240 s by default).
- **Injects context**: once per session it adds the repository's knowledge-page index plus a few recalled facts, capped by `injectMaxChars`.
- **Writes memory back**: when a turn goes idle, the latest user/assistant messages are retained into the bank and extracted into structured facts.
- **Gives the model tools**: ten `hindsight_local_*` tools to search and read pages, recall facts, remember, reflect, inspect status/logs, and start/stop the server.
- **Replaces the export handoff**: at session end it writes a short **handoff snapshot** (what was asked, the last conclusion, where it stopped) and injects it as "previous progress" at the start of the next session — no need to paste a whole exported transcript (see [Handoff snapshot](#handoff-snapshot)).

dsh-hindsight-local README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-hindsight-local
```

Restart DSH afterwards — the plugin reads its configuration at process start.

dsh-hindsight-local README · One-time server setup：The plugin does not ship a Python environment and does not run `uvx` inside a session (that is a multi-minute install). Prepare the server once:

```bash
uvx --from hindsight-embed@latest hindsight-embed profile create coding-agent \
  --port 9077 \
  --env HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek \
  --env HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat \

Then put the key into `~/.hindsight/profiles/coding-agent.env`:

dsh-hindsight-local README · One-time server setup：```
HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY=sk-...
HINDSIGHT_API_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=local
HINDSIGHT_API_PORT=9077
```

dsh-hindsight-local README · Configuration：Every field has a default; override only what you need:

```yaml
- id: hindsight-local
  config:
    apiUrl: http://127.0.0.1:9077
    autoStart: true

Resolution order: **plugin config → process env → profile env file → built-in defaults**.
dsh-hindsight-local README · Tools：`hindsight_local_status`, `_start`, `_stop`, `_logs`, `_search`, `_read`, `_recall`, `_remember`, `_reflect`, `_pages`.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Handoff snapshot：The "handoff document" tab in DSH is a full per-message export of the session (`bili export`, including chain-of-thought, tool arguments and raw tool output). Pasting it into a new session is long and expensive: in one measured export, assistant blocks were 63.7% of the file and chain-of-thought alone 47.6%, while what actually matters is where the work stopped and what comes next.

This plugin writes a snapshot instead:

dsh-hindsight-local README · Handoff snapshot：- At session end (`disposed`) it retains a **handoff snapshot** — project path, session id, every user request of that session (400 chars each), and the final assistant conclusion (800 chars), capped by `snapshotMaxChars` (default 1500).
- **Grouping** — every write of one session shares `document_id = dsh-session:<session id>`, so the server keeps it as a single document. Snapshot tags are `dsh-session` + `dsh-session-handoff`; per-turn fragments are `dsh-session` + `dsh-session-turn`.
- **Next session** — the injected block gains a "where it stopped last time" section: at most 3 recalled items, 220 chars each, never the full text.
- **Inspect** — `hindsight_local_recall("上次会话做到哪一步，下一步要做什么")`.
- **Disable** — `handoffSnapshot: false`.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Handoff snapshot：A snapshot is background, not an instruction: the injection says to treat it as context and re-check before relying on it, so an old conclusion cannot override what the user asks now.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Keeping data on another drive：By default the server keeps three things under your user profile:

| What | Default | How to move it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Embedded PostgreSQL (install + database) | `~/.pg0` | directory junction only (`pg0.exe` hard-codes its home and the server does not forward `data-dir`) |
| Embedding / reranker model cache | `~/.cache/huggingface` | `HF_HOME`, or a junction |
| uv cache (the server executable lives here) | `%LOCALAPPDATA%/uv/cache` | `UV_CACHE_DIR`, or a junction |

dsh-hindsight-local README · Keeping data on another drive：One command does the whole move (stops the server and the database, copies, creates junctions at the old paths, starts the server again and checks `/health`):

```bash
node scripts/relocate.mjs --to D:/hindsight-data
node scripts/relocate.mjs --to D:/hindsight-data --dry-run    # show the plan only
```

Then point the plugin at the same directory:

```yaml
- id: hindsight-local
  config:
    dataDir: D:/hindsight-data
```

dsh-hindsight-local README · Keeping data on another drive：`dataDir` makes the plugin export `UV_CACHE_DIR`, `HF_HOME` and `SENTENCE_TRANSFORMERS_HOME` before it spawns the server, so a fresh install can live on another drive without junctions. An existing `~/.pg0` still has to be moved by `relocate.mjs` (it creates the junction for you).

Each default location can also be overridden with `HINDSIGHT_PG0_DIR`, `HINDSIGHT_HF_DIR`, `HINDSIGHT_UV_DIR`.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Why not `hindsight-embed daemon start`：That wrapper gives up after a fixed 180 s readiness window, while a cold start installs ~450 MB of dependencies and downloads the embedding/reranker models (3–5 minutes on a real machine). It reports `Daemon Failed (Timeout)` while the process keeps initialising. This plugin launches `hindsight-api` directly and polls `/health` itself.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Windows notes (handled for you)：- The startup banner contains block characters that crash on a GBK console → `PYTHONUTF8=1` / `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` are injected.
- `huggingface_hub` (httpx) does not trust the Windows certificate store, so the first model download fails with `CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED`. Export your Windows roots to `~/.hindsight/winroot.pem` and the plugin uses it for `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` / `CURL_CA_BUNDLE`.

dsh-hindsight-local README · Relationship to the official plugin：Defaults are aligned on purpose (same bank name, same profile), so both plugins read the same memories — but both injecting would duplicate context, so keep only one. The official plugin's daemon mode is skipped on Windows because its last LLM probe is `which claude`; this plugin does not rely on it.
